fields.name: seed
fields.title: Seed
fields.description: Random seed for reproducibility

fields.name: resolution
fields.title: Resolution
fields.description: Output resolution; higher is slower but more detailed

fields.name: ss_guidance_strength
fields.title: Ss Guidance Strength
fields.description: How closely the initial 3D structure follows the input image. Higher values produce more faithful but potentially noisier results.

fields.name: ss_guidance_rescale
fields.title: Ss Guidance Rescale
fields.description: Dampens artifacts from high guidance in stage 1. Lower values allow stronger guidance effects, higher values stabilize the output.

fields.name: ss_guidance_interval_start
fields.title: Ss Guidance Interval Start
fields.description: Fraction of the denoising process at which classifier-free guidance starts for stage 1 (sparse structure). Guidance is only applied between interval_start and interval_end; outside this window the model runs unguided. Lower values apply guidance earlier.

fields.name: ss_guidance_interval_end
fields.title: Ss Guidance Interval End
fields.description: Fraction of the denoising process at which classifier-free guidance ends for stage 1 (sparse structure). Must be >= ss_guidance_interval_start.

fields.name: ss_sampling_steps
fields.title: Ss Sampling Steps
fields.description: Number of denoising steps for the initial structure. More steps = slower but potentially higher quality.

fields.name: ss_rescale_t
fields.title: Ss Rescale T
fields.description: Controls noise schedule sharpness for structure generation. Higher values produce sharper transitions.

fields.name: shape_slat_guidance_strength
fields.title: Shape Slat Guidance Strength
fields.description: How closely the detailed geometry follows the input image. Higher values add more detail but may introduce noise.

fields.name: shape_slat_guidance_rescale
fields.title: Shape Slat Guidance Rescale
fields.description: Dampens artifacts from high guidance in the shape stage. Increase if you see noisy geometry.

fields.name: shape_slat_guidance_interval_start
fields.title: Shape Slat Guidance Interval Start
fields.description: Fraction of the denoising process at which classifier-free guidance starts for stage 2 (shape refinement). Guidance is only applied between interval_start and interval_end.

fields.name: shape_slat_guidance_interval_end
fields.title: Shape Slat Guidance Interval End
fields.description: Fraction of the denoising process at which classifier-free guidance ends for stage 2 (shape refinement). Must be >= shape_slat_guidance_interval_start.

fields.name: shape_slat_sampling_steps
fields.title: Shape Slat Sampling Steps
fields.description: Number of denoising steps for shape refinement. More steps = slower but potentially smoother geometry.

fields.name: shape_slat_rescale_t
fields.title: Shape Slat Rescale T
fields.description: Controls noise schedule sharpness for shape refinement. Higher values produce sharper geometric details.

fields.name: tex_slat_guidance_strength
fields.title: Tex Slat Guidance Strength
fields.description: How closely the texture follows the input image colors. Higher values produce more vivid but potentially oversaturated textures.

fields.name: tex_slat_guidance_rescale
fields.title: Tex Slat Guidance Rescale
fields.description: Dampens artifacts from high guidance in the texture stage. Increase if textures look noisy or have color banding.

fields.name: tex_slat_guidance_interval_start
fields.title: Tex Slat Guidance Interval Start
fields.description: Fraction of the denoising process at which classifier-free guidance starts for stage 3 (texture). Guidance is only applied between interval_start and interval_end.

fields.name: tex_slat_guidance_interval_end
fields.title: Tex Slat Guidance Interval End
fields.description: Fraction of the denoising process at which classifier-free guidance ends for stage 3 (texture). Must be >= tex_slat_guidance_interval_start.

fields.name: tex_slat_sampling_steps
fields.title: Tex Slat Sampling Steps
fields.description: Number of denoising steps for texture generation. More steps = slower but potentially cleaner textures.

fields.name: tex_slat_rescale_t
fields.title: Tex Slat Rescale T
fields.description: Controls noise schedule sharpness for texture generation. Higher values produce sharper texture details.

fields.name: decimation_target
fields.title: Decimation Target
fields.description: Target number of vertices in the final mesh. Lower values produce smaller files but less detail. 500k is good for most uses, reduce to 20k-50k for web/mobile.

fields.name: texture_size
fields.title: Texture Size
fields.description: Resolution of the texture image baked onto the mesh. Higher values capture finer surface details but produce larger files.

fields.name: remesh
fields.title: Remesh
fields.description: Rebuild the mesh topology for cleaner triangles. Slower but usually produces better results for downstream use (animation, 3D printing, etc).

fields.name: remesh_band
fields.title: Remesh Band
fields.description: Controls how far remeshing can move vertices from the original surface. Higher values allow more smoothing but may lose fine details.

fields.name: remesh_project
fields.title: Remesh Project
fields.description: How much to project remeshed vertices back onto the original surface. 0 = no projection (smoother), 1 = full projection (preserves detail).

fields.name: uv_unwrap_angle_threshold_deg
fields.title: Uv Unwrap Angle Threshold Deg
fields.description: Maximum angle (in degrees) between adjacent face normals allowed within a single UV chart. Lower values produce more charts with less distortion; higher values produce fewer, larger charts with potentially more stretching.

fields.name: uv_unwrap_refine_iterations
fields.title: Uv Unwrap Refine Iterations
fields.description: Number of local refinement passes during UV chart computation. Higher values produce cleaner chart boundaries at the cost of additional UV-unwrap time.

fields.name: uv_unwrap_global_iterations
fields.title: Uv Unwrap Global Iterations
fields.description: Number of global clustering passes during UV chart computation. More passes produce more balanced charts.

fields.name: uv_unwrap_smooth_strength
fields.title: Uv Unwrap Smooth Strength
fields.description: Smoothing strength applied to UV chart boundaries. Higher values reduce visible seams but may introduce UV distortion.
